# Glitch cut

Cuts to the next image through digital damage: blocks flip over one by one around the middle while slices shift and the color channels split. The damage fades in and out with the transition, and blocks switch at staggered moments so the frame never flashes as a whole.

<EffectDemo effect="glitch-cut" />

## Usage

```ts
import { createTransition, toHoloEffect } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { glitchCut } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/glitch-cut';

const effect = glitchCut({ preset: 'subtle' });

// Standalone: blend two textures as progress goes from 0 to 1.
const player = createTransition(renderer, effect, {
  from: textureA,
  to: textureB,
});
player.progress = 0.5;
player.render();

// With HoloCSS: hand it to transition3d().
import { transition3d } from '@mk7s/holocss/three';
await transition3d(fromElement, toElement, toHoloEffect(effect), {
  target,
  update,
});
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.blockSize = 32`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter   | Type    | Default | Range      | Description                                                                                                         |
| ----------- | ------- | ------- | ---------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `blockSize` | number  | `32`    | 4 – 128 px | Size of the blocks that switch.                                                                                     |
| `spread`    | number  | `0.6`   | 0 – 0.98   | How much of the transition the block switching is spread over.                                                      |
| `slices`    | number  | `24`    | 2 – 120    | Number of horizontal slices.                                                                                        |
| `density`   | number  | `0.4`   | 0 – 1      | Fraction of slices that shift.                                                                                      |
| `shift`     | number  | `0.08`  | 0 – 0.5    | Largest sideways shift of a slice, as a fraction of the width.                                                      |
| `split`     | number  | `12`    | 0 – 60 px  | Largest color channel split.                                                                                        |
| `steps`     | integer | `3`     | 1 – 6      | How many times the slices re-roll across the transition; kept low so a one-second cut stays within the flash limit. |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset    | Settings                                                    |
| --------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| `subtle`  | `shift: 0.03`, `split: 4`, `density: 0.25`                  |
| `heavy`   | `shift: 0.12`, `split: 20`, `density: 0.5`, `blockSize: 48` |
| `fine`    | `blockSize: 8`, `slices: 60`                                |
| `instant` | `spread: 0.1`, `steps: 2`                                   |

Apply one with `glitchCut({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Transitions · tracked as story X13.4 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Kind:** transition. `createTransition(renderer, effect, { from, to })` runs it on two textures; `toHoloEffect(effect)` turns it into a HoloCSS `ThreeEffect` (parameters are baked in when called), with the `hcss-depth` CSS fallback. See [transitions](/guide/transitions).
- **Motion:** driven by `progress` from your timeline. HoloCSS skips transitions when motion is off; standalone, set `progress = 1` instead of animating.
- **Size:** 6.5 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/glitch-cut`, including the shared effect runtime.

## Credits

Original implementation (MIT). References: Hashed block switching staggered around the midpoint, with slice shifts and channel splits under a sin² envelope.

## Related

- [RGB split glitch](./rgb-split-glitch) — Red and blue jump apart in quick, seeded steps, like a misaligned digital signal.
- [Slice shift](./slice-shift) — Cuts the frame into horizontal (or vertical) slices that slide out of line by random amounts, re-cutting a few times a second.
- [Pixelate transition](./pixelate-transition) — Breaks the image into ever larger blocks, switches to the next image at the coarsest point, then sharpens back down to single pixels.
